data.name: Shraddha
data.gender_notes: Shraddha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śraddhā, 'faith, trust, devotion'. Its root is Sanskrit śraddhā (श्रद्धा). A central concept in Hindu tradition. Shraddha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Faith; trust; devotion”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shraddha expresses “Faith; trust; devotion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śraddhā, 'faith, trust, devotion'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shraddha total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_english.name: Shraddha
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śraddhā, 'faith, trust, devotion'. Its root is Sanskrit śraddhā (श्रद्धा). A central concept in Hindu tradition. Shraddha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Faith; trust; devotion”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Shraddha is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Faith; trust; devotion”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Shraddha is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Faith; trust; devotion” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Shraddha; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Shraddha is a virtue mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Vedas and the Bhagavad Gita.

historical_references.reference: A central concept in Hindu tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Shraddha.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
